issues: Initial render shows 00:00:00 for first ~1-2 seconds (does not tick visibly in the first 2.5s window of a fresh encounter). After reload the timer correctly reflects elapsed server time (00:00:06). Likely clock-skew/next-tick scheduling. Not blocking but worth confirming the useEffect increments on the second after started_at rather than waiting for the next full-second boundary.

critical_code_review_comments: Timer in SafetyHeader: initial increment lag observed (00:00:00 for ~2.5s on fresh encounter). After reload it ticks correctly. Consider computing elapsed = max(0, now - started_at) each render instead of a setInterval(+1) counter so it is always accurate.

Patients.jsx auto-selects a single search hit (good UX) which means [data-testid=patient-lookup-result] is not rendered in that case; this is expected behavior and tests should rely on start-encounter-btn visibility rather than clicking a result when count==1.
